name: Valentine no Tadashii Shitsuke
original_name: バレンタインの正しいしつけ
source:
A love-starved, emotionally unstable guy and a princely (samurai-like) heroine. 

The heroine (default name: Rui), captain of the archery club, carries herself with a confidence that even the boys admire—and she’s incredibly popular with the girls! 
On a winning streak and seemingly unstoppable, her only worry is Shuuhei, a junior in the club and her childhood friend?!.

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/11392]freem[/url]]
